Description:
Enables the RawDataStreamServer instance for incoming connections.
For TCP the constructor marks the socket as ready to accept connection requests from a client
(see SWS_RDS_11312), and WaitForConnection() waits to accept an incoming connection
request. In the case of UDP, no connection is established, and the operation shall return with no
action.
